title: Camp Wurg
wikitext:
[[File:Camp Wurg.jpg|thumb|300px|Camp Wurg]]

'''Camp Wurg''' is, together with [[Camp Cagg]], [[Camp Boff|Boff]] and [[Camp Kosh|Kosh]], the homes of some of the [[Dustbelcher]] [[ogre]]s. One exception though was their leader, [[Boss Tho'grun]], who patrolled the [[Badlands]] between the four ogre bases.
